title: IVG Intense Salts Blue Razz Lemonade 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Blue Razz Lemonade pairs the tangy sweetness of Blue Raspberry with the zesty sparkle of Lemonade. Fruity syrup notes meet citrus sharpness for a refreshing flavour that’s both sweet and tart. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt delivers balanced flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Blue Razz Lemonade is best suited to mouth-to-lung (MTL) devices such as pod kits, pens and starter systems. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Blue Razz Lemonade offers a drink-inspired twist on a popular berry flavour.
